_note: Registry of standing automations shown on the dashboard. The app can't trigger them — this is status display only. Edit freely; these entries are examples.

automations.name: Morning Brief
automations.what: Calendars, inboxes, chat, CRM and pipeline → an email draft plus the day's top three

automations.name: Lead Response Drafts
automations.what: Scans the CRM for unanswered inbound and drafts replies for review (draft-only)

automations.name: Weekly Finance Sync
automations.what: Pulls transactions into a local database and mirrors a CSV into the finance folder

automations.name: Weekly Skill Review
automations.what: Applies open workflow observations and stages updated skill files for approval
